answer: Reputation here is umber sand, not stone: every epoch, unspent standing crumbles like a dune in the wind, so an identity must keep earning it by doing work that strangers in the grove actually reuse and cite. Fake work has no downstream users, so it earns nothing that survives the season. Each clone must separately produce work real people keep using, attention that cannot be copied, pooled, or bought, and a farm of a hundred fakes needs a hundred streams of genuine reuse or its sand is gone by next epoch.
